info.name: Public Ads API
info.description:
Public ad listing, detail, reviews and reports endpoints.

Base URL variable: {{url}}
All endpoints are under: {{url}}/api/v1/client/public/ads

Auth: Bearer {{user_token}} — set both variables in the Collection > Variables tab.

──────────────────────────────────────
FLOW
──────────────────────────────────────
1. GET  /public/ads          → List published ads (guests + auth, supports filters)
2. GET  /public/ads/{id}     → Full detail of a single published ad
3. POST /public/ads/{id}/reviews  → Submit a star rating + feedback (auth only, once per ad)
4. POST /public/ads/{id}/reports  → Report an ad with a reason (auth only, once per ad)

──────────────────────────────────────
FILTER QUERY PARAMS (for listing)
──────────────────────────────────────
search             – full-text: title, description, advertiser name, region, city, district, property_type, fal/ad license
purpose            – sale | rent
apartment_condition – new | used | under_construction
rental_period      – daily | weekly | monthly | yearly
furnishing_status  – furnished | unfurnished
price_min          – numeric minimum price
price_max          – numeric maximum price
property_type      – exact match on nhc_data->property_type (e.g. شقة)
region             – partial match on nhc_data->region
city               – partial match on nhc_data->city
district           – partial match on nhc_data->district

variable.description: Base URL e.g. http://localhost or https://api.yourdomain.com
Sanctum bearer token for the authenticated user (required for reviews and reports)
ID of the published ad to show / review / report

request.description:
Returns a paginated list (10 per page) of all published ads.
Accessible by guests and authenticated users.

Response shape:
{
  data: [ AdListResource, ... ],
  meta: { current_page, last_page, per_page, total },
  links: { first, last, prev, next }
}

Each card contains:
  title, advertiser_name, purpose, apartment_condition,
  price, rental_period, region, city, district,
  property_area, floor, furnishing_status,
  cover_image, is_nhc_verified, reviews_count, average_rating

query.description: Full-text search across title, description, advertiser name, region, city, district, property_type, fal/ad license numbers

request.description:
Search example — returns ads matching the keyword in any searchable field.
Works like a search engine: partial matches across multiple columns and nhc_data JSON fields.

request.description:
Full filter example combining all available filter params.
All params are optional — combine any subset.

Filters applied:
  purpose            → ads.purpose
  apartment_condition → ads.apartment_condition
  rental_period      → ads.rental_period
  furnishing_status  → ads.furnishing_status
  price_min/max      → ads.price range
  region/city/district → nhc_data JSON path (LIKE)
  property_type      → nhc_data JSON path (exact)

Full detail view of a single published ad.
Accessible by guests and authenticated users.

Guest vs Auth differences:
  - advertiser_phone  → hidden for guests, shown for auth users
  - nhc_mobile        → hidden for guests, shown for auth users

Response includes:
  advertiser_name, purpose, title, description, apartment_condition,
  region, city, district, latitude, longitude, location_description_on_moj_deed,
  property_area, number_of_rooms, living_rooms_count, bathrooms_count,
  floor, property_face, street_width, furnishing_status,
  property_type, property_age, property_usages[], property_utilities[],
  price, rental_period, property_price (NHC unit price),
  deed_number (sale only), plan_number, land_number,
  guarantees_and_their_duration, obligations_on_the_property,
  ownership_transfer_fee_type, responsible_employee_name,
  responsible_employee_phone_number,
  fal_license_number, ad_license_number, ad_license_url, is_nhc_verified,
  nhc_creation_date, nhc_end_date,
  cover_image, apartment_images[], apartment_video,
  reviews_count, average_rating, reviews[],
  nhc_mobile (auth only), advertiser_phone (auth only),
  created_at

HTTP 404 if ad not found or not published.

Submit a star rating and optional written feedback for a published ad.
Requires authentication (Bearer {{user_token}}).

Rules:
  - One review per user per ad (422 if already reviewed)
  - rating: required, integer 1–5
  - feedback: optional, string max 500 chars

HTTP 201 on success.
HTTP 422 if already reviewed or validation fails.
HTTP 404 if ad not found or not published.
HTTP 401 if not authenticated.

Minimal review — rating only, feedback is optional.
Requires authentication.

Report a published ad with a written reason.
Requires authentication (Bearer {{user_token}}).

Rules:
  - One report per user per ad (422 if already reported)
  - reason: required, string min 10 chars, max 500 chars

HTTP 201 on success.
HTTP 422 if already reported or validation fails.
HTTP 404 if ad not found or not published.
HTTP 401 if not authenticated.
